name: Slime Kingdom: The Tale of the Slime That Became a Hero
summary: A lighthearted fantasy deckbuilding RPG where you embark on a quest to become a legendary hero under the narration of the quirky Slime King. Explore a colorful world, complete quests, battle enemies using strategic card-based combat, and collect over 100 cards, trinkets, and upgrades to customize your build. Choose from various character classes, switch between them during combat, and use skill upgrades and dice rolls to influence your adventures as you face increasingly powerful foes.
